title: SseStreamState: scan_from overlap logic is correct and well-documented
description: The 3-byte overlap in scan_from (client.rs subscribe_events) and the comment explaining exactly which delimiter prefixes straddle chunk boundaries is correct engineering. A future contributor who sees 'saturating_sub(3)' without the comment might change it to 0 (correct but O(n) per chunk) or to the delimiter length (incorrect for straddled \r\n\r\n). The comment justifying the exact value should be preserved.
